title: The direct sum of two quasi-coherent modules is quasi-coherent
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\mathcal F_1,\mathcal F_2$ be quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $\mathcal F_1\oplus\mathcal F_2$ be the $\mathcal O_X$-module $W\mapsto\mathcal F_1(W)\oplus\mathcal F_2(W)$ (for $W\subseteq X$ open), with componentwise $\mathcal O_X(W)$-module structure and componentwise restriction maps; it is a sheaf, and together with the inclusions and projections of the two summands it is a direct sum (biproduct) of $\mathcal F_1$ and $\mathcal F_2$ in $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$. Then $\mathcal F_1\oplus\mathcal F_2$ is a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module.
